name: commvault-mcp
description: Query and manage your Commvault environment (jobs, SLA, storage, users, plans) in natural language.
long_description: Wraps Commvault's official open-source MCP server (github.com/Commvault/commvault-mcp-server) so Claude Desktop can talk to your CommCell or Metallic/Cloud tenant. Each install authenticates with an access token you generate yourself in Command Center under your own Commvault login — the extension never uses a shared credential. No Python, uv, or terminal setup required; Claude Desktop handles the runtime via the bundled uv package manager.

cc_server_url.title: Commvault Server URL
cc_server_url.description: On-premises CommCell only: your WebConsole/API base URL, e.g. https://yourcompany.example.com. If 'SaaS / Metallic tenant' below is enabled, this field is ignored -- the extension always uses https://api.metallic.io, not your tenant's pod hostname (e.g. m119.metallic.io) from the browser address bar.

is_metallic.title: SaaS / Metallic tenant
is_metallic.description: Enable if this is a Commvault Cloud (Metallic) SaaS tenant rather than an on-premises CommCell. When enabled, the Server URL field above is ignored.

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: Generate this yourself in Command Center: Security > Users and User Groups > your account > Create Access Token. Tied to your own login — never shared.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Issued alongside the access token in the same Command Center step.
